newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian minister to be at diamond talks-official.
newsitem.headline: Russian minister to be at diamond talks-official.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits plans to take part in talks on Friday on a new diamond deal between Russia and De Beers, a Finance Ministry official told Reuters.

She said the talks were between De Beers, the president Russia's main diamond-producing region of Sakha (formerly Yakutia) Mikhail Nikolayev and a representative from Russia's monopoly diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS).
The meeting was due to start at 1700 local time (1400 GMT).
On Friday morning Livshits was taken to hospital with a high temperature. The Finance Ministry official could not say how the minister felt now.
But she said that Livshits also wanted to keep to plans to meet Gary Ralfe, director of De Beers' London-based Central Selling Organisation, on Saturday.
Interfax news agency quoted an ARS source as saying talks on Thursday on a new deal with De Beers were very intensive, and negotiations had continued into the early hours on Friday.
The talks are centred around 10-15 adjustments the Russian government wants to make to the draft agreement reached between ARS and De Beers in September 1996.
De Beers stopped buying Russian diamonds at the end of last year, cancelling an interim arrangement after Moscow failed to give word on a new trade deal.
On Tuesday, Livshits said that Russia still wanted a gem export deal with De Beers.
